subject: Maths
topic: Four Operations and Order of Operations
title: BIDMAS/BODMAS
subtitle: Four Operations and Order of Operations · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can apply the correct order of operations (BIDMAS) to evaluate expressions.

key_vocab.definition: BIDMAS tells us the order: Brackets, Indices, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can apply the correct order of operations (BIDMAS) to evaluate expressions.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: BIDMAS -- BIDMAS tells us the order: Brackets, Indices, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Always follow BIDMAS: Brackets first, then Indices (powers), then Division/Multiplication (L to R), then Addition/Subtraction (L to R).
B → I → DM → AS
Brackets, Indices, Divide/Multiply, Add/Subtract

Key examples:
  ✓ 3 + 4 × 2 = 11  (multiply first)
  ✓ (3 + 4) × 2 = 14  (brackets first)
  ✓ 2² + 3 = 7  (indices before addition)
  ✗ 3 + 4 × 2 = 14  (left-to-right is wrong here)
  ✗ 8 ÷ 2(2+2) = 1  (common viral debate)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – multiplication before addition
  Calculate 5 + 3 × 4
  Multiplication first: 3 × 4 = 12
  Then add: 5 + 12
  = 17
  = 17
  (Without brackets, × and ÷ always come before + and −.)

Example 2 – brackets first
  Calculate (8 + 2) × 3
  Brackets first: 8 + 2 = 10
  Then multiply: 10 × 3
  = 30
  = 30
  (Brackets override the normal priority.)

sections.title: With indices
sections.content:
Remember: indices come after brackets but before × and ÷.

(a) 2² + 3²
(b) 5 × 2²
(c) (2 + 3)²
(d) 10 − 3²

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 3 + 4 × 2 = 11
✗ 3 + 4 × 2 = 14
✓ Brackets are always done first
✗ Addition comes before subtraction
✓ Indices are done before multiplication
